sections.title: 1. Data We Collect and How We Use It
sections.content: We collect and process the following information:

subsections.title: 1.1 Account Information
content: Email address: Required for account creation and authentication
Username: Optional identifier for your account (can be pseudonymous)

subsections.title: 1.2 Usage Data
content: Restaurant visits: Records of restaurants you've visited
Restaurant comparisons: Your win/lose/draw ratings between restaurants
User ID: An internal identifier to process your comparisons and visits

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
content: To provide and maintain our service
To calculate restaurant Elo ratings
To generate personalized restaurant leaderboards
To authenticate your account
To communicate important service-related notices

sections.title: 3. Data Storage and Security
content: All data is stored securely on [specify hosting service/location]
We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information
We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties

sections.title: 4. Third-Party Services
content: We use Google Places API to provide restaurant information
Please refer to Google's privacy policy for information about their data practices

sections.title: 5. Your Rights
content: You have the right to:
Access your personal data
Request correction of your data
Request deletion of your account and associated data
Export your data
Opt-out of non-essential communications

sections.title: 6. Data Retention
content: Account information is retained until you request deletion
Restaurant visits and comparisons remain in our system (anonymized) even after account deletion to maintain rating integrity

sections.title: 7. Cookies and Tracking
content: We use essential cookies for authentication
No third-party tracking cookies are used

sections.title: 8. Changes to Privacy Policy
sections.content: We reserve the right to update this privacy policy. Users will be notified of significant changes.

sections.title: 9. Contact Information
sections.content: For privacy-related questions, contact us at: [Your Contact Information]
